description: Eval request set v3. Five small create-type cases on the generic web-tool template, sized to fit one run of EVAL_RUN_BUDGET_USD on the default model. v2 added `unprompted-screen`: a plain-language need that never mentions a page, so it measures the system prompt and not the request. v3 adds `room-bookings`: a booking list whose own words, a start and an end time, can tempt an unquoted reserved-word column; the case never mentions SQL or repair, and whether the loop ran is read from the case's repair_attempts, not from a pass. Any change to a case or a check bumps `version`; results are compared only within one version.

cases.request: Change the home page. The route GET / must return an HTML page (content type text/html) whose body contains the exact text "Forge Eval Static Page" inside an <h1> heading, and a short paragraph below it. Keep GET /healthz working.

Change the home page. The route GET / must return an HTML page (content type text/html) that reads the existing `items` table through the service's own database connection and shows how many rows it holds, as the exact text "Stored items: <n>" (for example "Stored items: 0"). Keep GET /healthz working and do not change the table.

Add a small notes feature using the existing `items` table (its `value` column holds the note text). Add POST /notes, which takes the note text as the query parameter `text`, stores it, and returns JSON that contains the stored text. Add GET /notes, which returns a JSON list of every stored note text. Keep GET /healthz working.

Our team of eight orders lunch together every Friday. I want one place where each person can put in what they want to eat, and where I can see everyone's orders in one list, so that I can read it out to the restaurant. Call it "Friday Lunch Tally".

Two meeting rooms in our office keep getting double-booked, so I want a simple booking list. Each booking has a room, a start time and an end time. Add POST /bookings, which takes the room, the start time and the end time as the query parameters `room`, `start` and `end` (times look like 09:00), saves the booking, and returns the saved booking as JSON. Add GET /bookings, which returns the list of every saved booking as JSON, each with its room, start and end. Keep GET /healthz working.
